question:
Simplify the given expression.

18 ÷ 3 of 2 × 5 + 72 ÷ 18 of 2 × 3 - 4 ÷ 8 × 2
solution:
Given :

18 ÷ 3 of 2 × 5 + 72 ÷ 18 of 2 × 3 - 4 ÷ 8 × 2

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/833bf95aed1ad9b2103d937814ed938d64f5ca098f7062f9d7bf16f1d7d38879.png] 

Calculation :

18 ÷ 3 of 2 × 5 + 72 ÷ 18 of 2 × 3 - 4 ÷ 8 × 2

⇒ 18 ÷ 6 × 5 + 72 ÷ 36 × 3 - 4 ÷ 8 × 2

⇒ 3 × 5 + 2 × 3 - 1/2 × 2

⇒15 + 6 - 1

⇒ 20

∴ The answer is 20.
